scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.12 adds custom OpenAI-compatible models and the completed Aide workflow to the supported macOS desktop app, so the macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.12 adds custom OpenAI-compatible models and the completed Aide workflow to the supported Windows desktop app, so the Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.12 adds the same Electron Aide capabilities to Linux Experimental, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
